shortDescription: Allows operations with IONOS CLOUD Postgres Clusters (DBaaS PostgreSQL v2 API).

options.name: allow_replace
options.description: Boolean indicating if the resource should be recreated when the state cannot be reached in another way. This may be used to prevent resources from being deleted from specifying a different value to an immutable property. An error will be thrown instead

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: backup_id
options.description: The ID of the backup to initialize the cluster from when creating (restore from an existing backup).

options.name: backup_location
options.description: The Object Storage location where the backup will be created. The BackupLocations provides a list of supported locations.

options.name: backup_retention_days
options.description: Configures how many days cluster backups are retained.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: connection
options.description: Connection information of the PostgreSQL cluster. A dict with keys `datacenter` (ID or name), `lan` (ID or name) and `primary_instance_address` (IP and netmask of the cluster's primary instance, e.g. 192.168.1.101/24).

options.name: connection_pooler
options.description: Defines how database connections are managed and reused. Default value is DISABLED. DISABLED: No connection pooling is used. Each request opens a new connection, which is closed immediately after use. It ensures isolation but may impact performance due to frequent connection setup and teardown. TRANSACTION: Connections are pooled and reused for the duration of a transaction. Once the transaction completes, the connection is returned to the pool. This mode balances efficiency with transactional i

options.name: cores
options.description: The number of CPU cores per instance.

options.name: db_database
options.description: The name of the initial database to be created. Must be 63 characters or less and must include only alphanumeric characters (`[a-z0-9A-Z]`) and underscores (`_`).

options.name: db_password
options.description: The password for the master database user. Must meet the following requirements: - At least 8 characters long. - Contains at least one lowercase letter. - Contains at least one uppercase letter. - Contains at least one digit (0-9). - Contains at least one special character from the set: @$!%*?&

options.name: db_username
options.description: The username of the master database user. Must be 16 characters or less and must include only alphanumeric characters (`[A-Za-z0-9_]`) and underscores (`_`).

options.name: instances
options.description: The total number of instances in the cluster (one primary and n-1 secondary).

options.name: location
options.description: The location (region) in which the cluster will be created. Different service endpoints are used based on location, possible options are: "de/fra", "de/txl", "es/vit", "fr/par", "gb/lhr", "gb/bhx", "us/ewr", "us/las", "us/mci". If not set, the endpoint will be the one corresponding to "de/txl". The api_url, if set, overrides this.

options.name: logs_enabled
options.description: Allows or disallows the collection and reporting of logs for this cluster's observability. If the observability service is not activated on the contract, this setting is accepted but has no effect; log collection will not be enabled until the observability service is activated.

options.name: maintenance_window
options.description: A weekly 4 hour-long window, during which maintenance might occur. A dict with keys `time` (start of the maintenance window in UTC, e.g. "16:30:00") and `day_of_the_week` (e.g. "Sunday").

options.name: metrics_enabled
options.description: Allows or disallows the collection and reporting of metrics for this cluster's observability. If the observability service is not activated on the contract, this setting is accepted but has no effect; metric collection will not be enabled until the observability service is activated.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of your PostgreSQL cluster. Must be 63 characters or less and must begin and end with an alphanumeric character (`[a-z0-9A-Z]`) with dashes (`-`), underscores (`_`), dots (`.`), and alphanumerics between.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: postgres_cluster
options.description: The ID or name of an existing Postgres Cluster.

options.name: postgres_version
options.description: The PostgreSQL version for the cluster.

options.name: ram
options.description: The amount of memory per instance in gigabytes (GB).

options.name: recovery_target_time
options.description: Recovery target time (ISO 8601). Used to replay backups up to the specified time on creation, or for an in-place restore when state is `restore`.

options.name: replication_mode
options.description: Defines the replication mode across instances. - `ASYNCHRONOUS`: Propagates updates to other instances without waiting for confirmation. Offers higher performance but may result in temporary data inconsistencies during replication delays. - `STRICTLY_SYNCHRONOUS`: Only supported for clusters with at least 3 instances. Requires all instances to acknowledge the update before it is committed, guaranteeing strong consistency at the cost of potential performance impact in high-latency environments.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: storage_size
options.description: The amount of storage per instance in gigabytes (GB).

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
